Google Vertex AI returns 401 Unauthorized when the OAuth2 token is missing, expired, or the service account lacks aiplatform.endpoints.predict permission — verifies the error is mapped to Authentication

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest;
$req = \Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest::from_json(json_encode(["messages" => [["content" => "Hello", "role" => "user"]], "model" => "vertex_ai/gemini-2.0-flash"]));
$apiKey = getenv('API_KEY');
if ($apiKey === false || $apiKey === '') {
    throw new RuntimeException('API_KEY must be set');
}
$client = LiterLlm::createClient($apiKey);
try {
    $client->chat($req);
} catch (Throwable $error) {
    echo $error::class . ': ' . $error->getMessage() . "\n";
}
```
